description: Get what Laptop Part Finder covers in one call: brands, every model (slug, name, brand, and its part types with a fit count each), part-type counts, totals, data_revision and generated date. Use it before searching to check whether a brand, model or part type is covered at all. Use list_models to page through models, get_model_parts for a model's actual part numbers, and search_parts or resolve_request to find a specific part. Not covered means LPF has no documented fit, not that a part is incompatible. No arguments.
name: get_coverage

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Get coverage manifest
